packageRules.description: Build, test and packaging tooling. Nothing here reaches a consumer's rule set, so a green gate is the whole review. Majors stay individual so one broken tool cannot hold up the rest.
Workflow actions cannot change lint output at all. Majors stay individual: publish.yml only runs on release, so an actions major can pass every build and still break publishing.
playground-eslint9 pins the lower bound of the eslint and typescript peer ranges deliberately. Bumping it would leave nothing exercising the floor.
